h1. Getting Started

Welcome to your *Personal Documentation System*. This page explains how to use and extend it.

h2. What Is This?

A self-hosted, file-backed documentation portal that renders Confluence wiki markup and Mermaid diagrams in a clean Angular UI.

h2. Quick Start

# Start the Spring Boot backend:
{code:language=bash}
cd backend
./mvnw spring-boot:run
{code}

# Start the Angular frontend:
{code:language=bash}
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
{code}

# Open [http://localhost:4200|http://localhost:4200] in your browser.

h2. Writing Documents

Documents are plain-text files stored under {{~/personal-docs/docs/}}.

||Extension||Format||
|.wiki|Confluence wiki markup|
|.md|Markdown|
|.txt|Plain text (treated as wiki)|

Place files in subdirectories to create categories:

{noformat}
docs/
├── getting-started.wiki
├── architecture/
│   └── overview.wiki
└── team/
    └── on-boarding.wiki
{noformat}

h2. Supported Syntax

{info}
See the *Architecture* document for a full syntax reference including Mermaid diagrams and all Confluence macros.
{info}

h2. Data Flow

{mermaid}
graph LR
    A[.wiki / .md file] --> B[Spring Boot API]
    B --> C[Angular Frontend]
    C --> D[confluenceParser.js]
    D --> E[mermaidLoader.js]
    E --> F[Rendered Page]
{/mermaid}
